scope: IE-P6: paired coverage x short-recurrence repair and learned local representation; no original roadmap renumbering.
matrix: A standard/uniform; B standard/50%targeted; C standard+temporal/uniform; D standard+temporal/50%targeted. Three matched seeds each, all start from own P5 standard frozen weights. Adam reset identically; same LR and total updates. Extra temporal work reported, not equal FLOPs.
targeting: One fixed training-only2049voltage grid, pooled across all3parent seeds. Worst endpoint transition error / zscale aggregated into64voltage bins; weights proportional to bin maximum plus20%mean floor. All seeds share distribution;50%uniform support retained. Never derived from fresh or historical outcomes.
temporal: Every4updates add1.0 times mean squared normalized gate error across8variable-voltage steps and128paths sampled from a4096path training-only pool with precomputed teacher targets. All arms evaluate identical paths; only C,D backpropagate temporal term. Half pool paths random-walk increments8mV, half independent voltage jumps; initial gate uniform. Scale remains parent zscale. No constant400 endpoint training term or logit penalty.
base_loss: Identical P5 standard: normalized transition MSE + u MSE + .01 log(z/zscale+1e-8) MSE.
local_representation: Two trainable uniform piecewise-linear normalized coefficient tables:81/161knots (2/1mV).34values per knot; convex interpolation; parameters projected into[0,1], positive normalized z floor1e-7. Initialized from same-seed P5 neural predictions, never analytic target values. Fit same uniform minibatches and base loss as A, same AdamLR/steps. Not equal initial function/parameter count; record initialization discrepancy, bytes and full actual inference. This is learned local numerical operator, not a dense neural network or guaranteed compression.
selection: New dev seed, common criterion max(transitionRMSE/.001,transitionmax/.01,constant400endpointmax/.03,short8stepmax/.03). Per-member minimum over registered checkpoints. Freeze hashes before fresh. Also compare matched budget checkpoints, not selected alone.
deployment: All12selectedMLPs are additionally tabulated at.25mV using only their outputs. Conversion on65537point grid,x0=0/1, tolerance5e-5. No conversion is trained. Local operators deployed directly, no padding or unused heads.
attribution: 18exact u_all,z_all and Ca/Na/K/IhIm group swaps on3P5standardparents; historical only, no selection/timing. Save u/z joint endpoint maps, pergate and64bin error profiles, and balanced component gradient cosines on training-only probes. Negative interactions retained; no unique-cause claim.
contrasts: B-A,C-A,D-B,D-C and interaction(D-C)-(B-A), paired per seed. Matched-budget curves use development only; selected checkpoints use fresh. Primary accuracy contrast >=20%median reduction of threshold-normalized joint fresh gate/path score, consistent direction3/3; report partial/heterogeneous otherwise. H_optimization uses A30k vsA0 development curve plus selectedA versus same-parent on new fresh, not P5oldfresh. Local versus A has representation/init/parameter confounds explicitly disclosed. No significance claim from3seeds.
input_contract: V,explicit18gates;17V-dependent approximated. SK,newCa ordering,calcium law,readout,synapses,solver unchanged. dt.1ms,[-100,60]mV, no time-step coarsening or hidden state compression.

hypotheses.H_optimization: Further matched standard optimization reduces residual errors; checkpoint curves distinguish improvement from plateau, not budget/data/reset separately.
hypotheses.H_coverage: Training-only error-targeted voltage sampling reduces worst-case errors without sacrificing uniform support.
hypotheses.H_temporal: Short variable-voltage recurrence supervision reduces accumulation better than one-step supervision alone.
hypotheses.H_interaction: Coverage and temporal training have complementary effects; factorial interaction measured rather than assumed.
hypotheses.H_conflict: P5balanced loss terms show conflicting gradients or scales on new parent probes; diagnostic association, not causal explanation by itself.
hypotheses.H_representation: A directly learned local operator can improve cost-quality tradeoff over denseMLP; bytes and initialization discrepancy must be disclosed.
hypotheses.H_attribution: New P5parents retain conditional z/calcium-group sensitivity observed in older parents; exact swaps are not selectable candidates.

validation: Parent SHA; independent clippedAdam vs batched; interpolation and projection invariants; fixed targeting provenance; temporal recurrence and gradients; freeze before fresh; compile/eager/graph numeric preflights; worker failures technical not scientific. No training/timing contention.
exclusions: No automatic promotion; no new native confirmation; Task35 opened diagnostic only. Fixed resident timing excludes host RNG/events/transfers. No end-to-end speedup claim, OpenEvolve, custom kernels or hardware change. New tests may guide later work only after reporting all arms. Outside voltage domain unqualified. No promise of success.
